lines.text: So you twisted reaching into the back seat?
I'm coming in with a sharp catch under my left shoulder blade when I breathe in deep.
Hard to point at your own back, mind, it could be a bit higher.
Let me have a look. Yes, there's a stiff, tender joint where the rib meets the spine on the left, about level with the bottom of the shoulder blade.
I'd like to do a quick manipulation there, you'll probably hear a pop. Are you happy for a crack?
Yes, go for it, I'm happy for a crack.
Done. Breathe in deep for me. Better? Keep turning side to side every hour while you're at work, and no lifting the grandkids till Monday.
